model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for various language models across different linguistic families. The horizontal axis represents the linguistic families, ordered from left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled “effect,” ranges from 0 to approximately 30 and employs a linear scale with tick intervals of 5 units, indicating values from 0 to 30. The bars are colored by language model type: “XLM-L2” is represented by white bars, “XLM-L2” is represented by orange bars, “mBERT-R2” is represented by red bars, “XLM-R2” is represented by teal bars, and “mBERT-B2” is represented by navy blue bars. The tallest bar, representing XLM-L2, reaches approximately 28.5, while the shortest bar, representing mBERT-B2, reaches approximately 2.5. Error bars, representing standard deviation, are present for each bar and are approximately 2 units in length. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their varying heights and colors.
